notes.title: Supermarket Shriek - Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[h2]Scream like a man! Scream like a goat! Scream together on October 23rd![/h2]

We're delighted to announce that Supermarket Shriek releases on 23rd October 2020 on Steam - giving you just over a month to find a buddy, warm up those vocal chords and prepare for the epic supermarket-based adventure that lies ahead! 

Keep an eye out for further Steam updates in the coming weeks prior to launch, where we'll be sharing more about what to expect from the game and even opporutunties to get your hands on it before it releases! 

In the meantime, if you haven't done so already we highly recommend that you check out our most recent updates:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1086460/view/2906467381821474646][h3][u]5 of Our "Favourite" Obstacles in Supermarket Shriek[/u][/h3][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1086460/view/2906466112182453764][h3][u]#SettleTheStore in Supermarket Shriek's 3 PvP Party Modes[/u][/h3][/url]

[previewyoutube=6q6xtayMQvk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for your support and stay tuned for more!
